value.apply: tilt = beta*(logV[home] - logV[away]); +0.5*tilt to home log-rate, -0.5*tilt to away. Absent team -> 0.

_meta.key_scheme: lowercase, NFD accent-stripped, non-letters removed; aliases applied
_meta.backtest_protocol: no-leakage expanding-origin walk-forward, DC refit every 90d on data < origin; test era from 2022-01-01; ordered-logit s,tau fit on calibration era 2018-01-01..2022-01-01
